name: rpiv-codex
description: Intent-first feature discovery, research, planning, revision, implementation, and plan-based validation for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Define feature intent, investigate repository behavior with verified evidence, shape complex work into reviewed vertical-slice plans, revise plans from grounded feedback, execute approved plans phase by phase, and validate the result against the plan.
defaultPrompt: Use $rpivc-discover to define a feature before implementation.
Use $rpivc-research to investigate a codebase area before design.
Use $rpivc-blueprint to turn research into an implement-ready phased plan.
Use $rpivc-revise to update an existing plan from review feedback or implementation discoveries.
Use $rpivc-implement to execute an approved plan one phase at a time or sequentially.
